name: ascend-avoid
description: A multiplayer game where players need to ascend and avoid obstacles

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:prod: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.preview:prod: npm run build && npm run start:prod
scripts.start:prod:safe: npm run verify:server && npm run start:prod
scripts.verify:server: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('./server/dist/index.js')) {console.error('❌ Server not built! Run: npm run build:server'); process.exit(1);} else {console.log('✅ Server build verified');}"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:multiplayer
scripts.test:unit: cd server && npx tsx tests/airflow.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/gameplay.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/fairness.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/pinwheel.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/shockwave.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/injury.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/bot-injury.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/size-combat.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/equal-rules.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/growth-bounds.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/captive-transfer.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/rapid-theft.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/body-pull.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/weapon-fleet.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/weapon-reward.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/spawn-safety.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/capture-finisher.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/weapon-theft.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/sustained-theft.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/incoming-shot.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/puff-impulse.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/shot-follow.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/shooter-power.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/vulnerable-inhale.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/black-hole.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/weapon-fairness.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/group-pressure.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/black-hole-rim.unit.ts && npx tsx tests/weapon-contest.unit.ts
scripts.deploy:local: npm run build:prod && npm run start:prod
